_approach: Almost beatless, exactly as Plugg Supply's future garage guide prescribes: one soft kick every two bars and a lone ghost clave tick are all that remain for four bars before the hats return. Ref: Plugg Supply 'How to Make Future Garage' ('mid-track breakdowns can go almost beatless'). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
